acsl.title: Damped Spring-Mass Oscillator with Energy Procedural
acsl.description: Second-order linear mechanical oscillator with viscous damping and an ACSL PROCEDURAL block computing kinetic, potential, and total mechanical energy.
acsl.code:
PROGRAM SPRING_MASS_OSCILLATOR
  ! Damped spring-mass oscillator with energy conservation procedural block
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT m = 2.0         ! Mass (kg)
    CONSTANT c = 0.6         ! Viscous damping coefficient (N*s/m)
    CONSTANT k = 18.0        ! Spring stiffness (N/m)
    CONSTANT x0 = 0.5        ! Initial displacement (m)
    CONSTANT v0 = 0.0        ! Initial velocity (m/s)
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.05
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.01
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      accel = (-k * x - c * v) / m
      v = INTEG(accel, v0)
      x = INTEG(v, x0)

      PROCEDURAL(energy = x, v)
        ke = 0.5 * m * v**2
        pe = 0.5 * k * x**2
        energy = ke + pe
      END
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 10.0, 'Oscillator simulation complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_energy = 0.5 * m * v**2 + 0.5 * k * x**2
  END
END

atopile.title: RC Low-Pass Anti-Aliasing Filter
atopile.description: First-order analog anti-aliasing RC low-pass filter (fc = 15.9 kHz) for a 12-bit ADC front-end importing standard resistor and capacitor generic components.
atopile.code:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor
from "generics/capacitors.ato" import Capacitor

module AntiAliasingFilter:
    signal sig_in
    signal adc_in
    signal gnd

    r_series = new Resistor
    c_shunt = new Capacitor

    r_series.resistance = 1kohm +/- 1%
    c_shunt.capacitance = 10nF +/- 5%

    sig_in ~> r_series ~> adc_in
    adc_in ~> c_shunt ~> gnd

    assert r_series.resistance within 980ohm to 1020ohm
    assert c_shunt.capacitance within 9nF to 11nF

bngl.description: Goldbeter-Koshland covalent modification switch modeled with explicit kinase and phosphatase binding rules and substrate site state transitions (~U to ~P).

begin model
begin parameters
  S0 500
  K0 25
  P0 25
  kf_k 0.01
  kr_k 0.2
  kcat_k 0.8
  kf_p 0.01
  kr_p 0.2
  kcat_p 0.6
end parameters

begin compartments
  Cyt 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  S(b,Y~U~P)
  K(s)
  P(s)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  S(b,Y~U) S0
  K(s) K0
  P(s) P0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules UnphosS S(Y~U)
  Molecules PhosS S(Y~P)
  Molecules KinaseComplex K(s!1).S(b!1)
  Molecules PhosphataseComplex P(s!1).S(b!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  KinaseBind: K(s) + S(b,Y~U) <-> K(s!1).S(b!1,Y~U) kf_k, kr_k
  KinaseCat: K(s!1).S(b!1,Y~U) -> K(s) + S(b,Y~P) kcat_k
  PhosBind: P(s) + S(b,Y~P) <-> P(s!1).S(b!1,Y~P) kf_p, kr_p
  PhosCat: P(s!1).S(b!1,Y~P) -> P(s) + S(b,Y~U) kcat_p
end reaction rules
end model

csmp.title: Damped Harmonic Oscillator
csmp.description: Second-order linear spring-mass-damper mechanical oscillator using paired INTGRL integrators and a NOSORT energy balance calculation.
csmp.code:
* IBM System/360 CSMP Damped Harmonic Oscillator
TITLE DAMPED HARMONIC OSCILLATOR
INITIAL
  PARAM M = 1.5, C = 0.45, K = 12.0
  INCON X0 = 0.25, V0 = 0.0
  WN = SQRT(K / M)
DYNAMIC
SORT
  XDD = (-C * XD - K * X) / M
  XD = INTGRL(V0, XDD)
  X = INTGRL(X0, XD)
NOSORT
  ENERGY = 0.5 * M * XD**2 + 0.5 * K * X**2
TERMINAL
  FINAL_E = ENERGY
TIMER FINTIM = 10.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 0.5, OUTDEL = 0.5
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT X, XD, ENERGY
PRTPLT X(XD)
END
STOP

esterel.code:
% Digital Stopwatch with Start/Stop, Lap Freeze, and Strong Reset Preemption
module Stopwatch:
input TICK, START_STOP, LAP, RESET;
output DISPLAY_TICK, LAP_FROZEN, CLEARED;
relation START_STOP # RESET;

loop
  abort
    [
      loop
        await START_STOP;
        abort
          every TICK do
            emit DISPLAY_TICK
          end
        when START_STOP;
        pause
      end
    ||
      loop
        await LAP;
        abort
          sustain LAP_FROZEN
        when LAP;
        pause
      end
    ]
  when RESET do
    emit CLEARED
  end;
  pause
end
end module

fortran.title: 1D Explicit Heat Conduction Equation Solver
fortran.description: Finite-difference FTCS explicit parabolic PDE solver for one-dimensional transient heat diffusion along an aluminum rod with fixed Dirichlet boundaries.
fortran.code:
subroutine heat1d_step(t_mid)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: t_mid
  real(8) :: u(41), u_new(41)
  real(8) :: r
  integer :: i, n

  r = 0.25d0

  do i = 1, 41
    u(i) = 20.0d0
    u_new(i) = 20.0d0
  end do
  u(1) = 100.0d0
  u(41) = 20.0d0

  do n = 1, 200
    u_new(1) = 100.0d0
    u_new(41) = 20.0d0
    do i = 2, 40
      u_new(i) = u(i) + r * (u(i + 1) - 2.0d0 * u(i) + u(i - 1))
    end do
    do i = 1, 41
      u(i) = u_new(i)
    end do
  end do

  t_mid = u(21)
end subroutine heat1d_step

gams.title: Diet and Nutrition Cost-Minimization LP
gams.description: Minimum-cost daily ration formulation selecting food servings to satisfy minimum calorie, protein, and calcium requirements with upper sodium limits.
gams.code:
$title Diet and Nutrition Cost-Minimization LP
Sets
  f  foods     / oats, chicken, eggs, milk, beans /
  n  nutrients / calories, protein, calcium / ;

Parameters
  price(f)  cost per serving in USD
    / oats     0.35
      chicken  2.40
      eggs     0.55
      milk     0.65
      beans    0.45 /
  nmin(n)   minimum daily requirement
    / calories 2000
      protein  55
      calcium  800 /
  maxsrv(f) maximum servings per day
    / oats     4
      chicken  3
      eggs     3
      milk     5
      beans    4 / ;

Table nut(f,n)  nutrient content per serving
             calories  protein  calcium
  oats          300       10       40
  chicken       280       32       15
  eggs          160       13       55
  milk          150        8      300
  beans         260       15       80 ;

Variables
  x(f)   servings of food f
  total  total daily food cost (USD) ;
Positive Variable x ;

x.up(f) = maxsrv(f) ;

Equations
  obj       total diet cost
  req(n)    minimum daily nutrient requirement ;

obj..     total =e= sum(f, price(f)*x(f)) ;
req(n)..  sum(f, nut(f,n)*x(f)) =g= nmin(n) ;

Model diet / all / ;
Solve diet using lp minimizing total ;
Display x.l, total.l ;

nmodl.description: Classic squid giant axon Hodgkin-Huxley fast sodium (m^3 h), delayed rectifier potassium (n^4), and leak conductances for action potential generation.
nmodl.code:
TITLE Hodgkin-Huxley Voltage-Gated Sodium and Potassium Channels

NEURON {
  SUFFIX hh_axon
  USEION na READ ena WRITE ina
  USEION k READ ek WRITE ik
  NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT il
  RANGE gnabar, gkbar, gl, el, gna, gk, ina, ik, il
  GLOBAL minf, hinf, ninf, mtau, htau, ntau
}

PARAMETER {
  gnabar = 0.12 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gkbar = 0.036 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gl = 0.0003 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  ena = 50.0 (mV)
  ek = -77.0 (mV)
  el = -54.3 (mV)
}

STATE {
  m
  h
  n
}

ASSIGNED {
  v (mV)
  gna (S/cm2)
  gk (S/cm2)
  ina (mA/cm2)
  ik (mA/cm2)
  il (mA/cm2)
}

INITIAL {
  m = 0.05
  h = 0.60
  n = 0.32
}

BREAKPOINT {
  SOLVE states METHOD cnexp
  gna = gnabar * (m^3) * h
  ina = gna * (v - ena)
  gk = gkbar * (n^4)
  ik = gk * (v - ek)
  il = gl * (v - el)
}

DERIVATIVE states {
  m' = (minf - m) / mtau
  h' = (hinf - h) / htau
  n' = (ninf - n) / ntau
}

sbml.title: Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics
sbml.description: Two-step enzymatic catalysis (E + S <-> ES -> E + P) demonstrating enzyme-substrate complex formation, steady-state turnover, and product accumulation.
sbml.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MichaelisMentenKinetics" name="Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cytosol" name="Cytosol" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" name="Substrate" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="12.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="E" name="Free Enzyme" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="1.5" constant="false"/>
      <species id="ES" name="Enzyme-Substrate Complex" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="P" name="Product" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="k_on" name="Association Rate Constant" value="0.6" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_off" name="Dissociation Rate Constant" value="0.15" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_cat" name="Catalytic Turnover Rate" value="0.45" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_bind" name="Substrate Binding" reversible="true">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="S" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * (k_on * S * E - k_off * ES)</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_cat" name="Catalytic Conversion" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="P" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * k_cat * ES</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

simscript.title: Parallel Machine Repair Shop with Breakdowns
simscript.description: Industrial maintenance shop with multiple repair technicians servicing stochastic machine failures using Erlang repair durations and resource utilization accumulation.
simscript.code:
'' MODEL: MachineRepairShop
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY FAILED.UNIT HAS A SEVERITY AND BELONGS TO REPAIR.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE FAILURE.GEN
    INCLUDE FAILED.UNIT
  RESOURCES
    EVERY TECHNICIAN
  DEFINE REPAIR.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE DOWN.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY MEAN.DOWNTIME AS THE MEAN OF DOWN.TIME
  ACCUMULATE TECH.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.TECHNICIAN
  ACCUMULATE BACKLOG AS THE MEAN OF N.Q.TECHNICIAN
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY TECHNICIAN(1)
  LET U.TECHNICIAN = 3
  ACTIVATE A FAILURE.GEN NOW
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS FAILURE.GEN
  ACTIVATE A FAILED.UNIT NOW
  ACTIVATE A FAILURE.GEN IN EXPONENTIAL.F(3.5, 1) HOURS
END

PROCESS FAILED.UNIT
  FILE THIS FAILED.UNIT IN REPAIR.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 TECHNICIAN
  REMOVE FIRST FAILED.UNIT FROM REPAIR.QUEUE
  WORK ERLANG.F(6.0, 2, 2) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 TECHNICIAN
  DESTROY THIS FAILED.UNIT
END
